jobs_results.title: I&O Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
For one of our best clients with office in Madrid, we are looking for a I&O Project Manager to participate in a global project. This is a position to work on behalf of the client's region, in a global outsourced IT Organization.

Profile:
• Minimum 5 years' experience as Project Manager
• Experience working in global and multicultural environments or offshore outsourcing organizations.
• Proficiency in Cloud Services, particularly AWS, with a strong understanding of its implementation and management.
• Familiarity with Data Center shared infrastructures.
• Experience working with both Waterfall and Agile methodologies
• Project Management certifications such as PMP, ITIL v3, and Scrum are highly desirable
• Fluent in English.

Tasks:
• Act as a technical project manager on behalf of the Zone Delivery Service
• Ensure successful service delivery - SLA achievement and high level of customer satisfaction.
• Remove all obstacles to Country satisfaction and / or financial... performance.

Conditions:
• Location: Madrid
• Hybrid and full-time: 2 days per week onsite
• Contract: Freelance, services with Huxley
• Rate according to experience
• Start Date: ASAP

If you are interested, please apply to this opportunity and we will reach out to you to discuss the rest of the details

jobs_results.title: Clinical Project Manager - Sponsor Dedicated - Anywhere in EMEA
jobs_results.description:
Clinical Project Manager

The Study Lead Country Operations (SLCO) is the primary point of contact for the Country Operations (CO) team at the global study level and will act as a core study team member. The SLCO will be accountable for coordinating and driving activities performed by country operations including start up, monitoring, site oversight, quality and specific study deliverables. The SLCO will, therefore, be involved in study documentation review, coordinating CO activities globally, and will act as a liaison for other key stakeholders for relevant site and monitoring issues at country level.

The SLCO be responsible for liaising with Country Operations personnel to conduct the feasibility process, providing feedback to the study team regarding potential site and patient numbers.

The SLCO is responsible for utilizing and interpreting data from analytic tools, in conjunction with country and regional intelligence to proactively identify risks to quality and compliance and... to develop and implement mitigation plans to address these risks.

The SLCO may be required to visit sites with the CRAs (CRO, FSP or in-house as applicable), or with other personnel (e.g. CO, Global Medical Affairs, etc.) for Sponsor Oversight, Inspection Readiness or Engagement Visits.

Job Accountabilities & Responsibilities

Accountable for
• Monitoring and site oversight globally assigned study(ies), representing the monitoring function on the Global Study Team
• Aggregation and communication of deliverables for assigned study(ies), globally, to the Clinical Program Lead (CPL)
• Resourcing and training of Functional Service Provider (FSP) CRAs for assigned study(ies) Validating local CRO resources, as necessary, to support execution of the study(ies)
• Developing and/or reviewing applicable study documents including training materials and reports
• Delivery of appropriate protocol and indication training to Country Operations teams
• Coordinationof start up and recruitment activities at the study level, across all countries
• Ensuring deployment of inspection readiness measures: including preparation of tools and required documentation

Responsible For:
• Liaison between Country Operations (CO) teams and the Global Study Team: act as the central point of contact for the CO team for assigned studies
• Standardization of study conduct and clinical monitoring proceses across study(ies)
• Collection of site nominations and communications thereof to the CPL
• Track trends occurring within the study that may impact other studies and communicate to the SLCO team and other key stakeholderes
• Together with the the SLCO team, standardize processes across the studies to improve efficiencies in CO activities
• Define monitoring requirements including components of Risk Based Monitoring (RBM)
• Support risk management and signal detection at a study level
• Act as a Subject Matter Expert for Sponsor Inspections by Regulatory Agencies or during audits
• Review quality metrics and provide solutions for continuous improvement
• Maintain a thorough knowledge of disease area and protocols

Essential Qualifications
• Extensive clinical trial experience across a range of highly complex disease areas
• Demonstrated capability of effective CRA and site oversight
• Solid knowledge of clinical development processes with strong emphasis on monitoring
• Track record of establishing effective relationships with investigator sites
• Ability to lead, troubleshoot and influence for quality and delivery
• A track record of ensuring GCP compliance and successful risk management of complex clinical studies is expected
• Ability to travel as required internationally and domestically. Demonstrates flexibility in schedule and willingness to travel up to 25%

Preferred Qualifications
• Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in one of the disciplines related to clinical practice/health care, life sciences or drug development is required. A clinical or advanced degree (RN, MPH, MS, MA, MBA, PharmD) is preferred.
• 8+ years of clinical research experience in biopharma or CRO
• 4+ years of clinical project management wit regional or global scope
• Demonstrated project management skills across multiple highly complex clinical studies
• Experience of managing multiple studies including extensive experience in the management and oversight of CROs
• Experience of oncology clinical research is beneficial

We invite you to join IQVIA™
• Recognized by Great Place to Work as the second best company to work for (March 2019)
• FORTUNE Magazine's World's Most Admired Companies list for the third year in a row (January 2021)
• Recognized by the 2016 Scrip Awards as the Best Full-service Provider Contract Research Organization (CRO)
• Awarded the 2016 Eagle Award from the Society for Clinical Research Sites (SCRS) for the fourth consecutive year.
• A site-nominated award recognizing contract research organizations (CRO) and biopharmaceutical sponsors dedicated to building positive relationships with research sites through leadership, professionalism and integrity.
• IQVIA™ named in The International Association of Outsourcing Professionals (IAOP) 2017 Global Outsourcing 100® List which recognizes the world’s best service providers across a range of industries.

We know that meaningful results require not only the right approach but also the right people. Regardless of your role, we invite you to reimagine healthcare with us. You will have the opportunity to play an important part in helping our clients drive healthcare forward and whatever your career goals, we are here to ensure you get there!

Are you interested or do you know the ideal candidate?
• If you know the right candidate or for more information on this role please contact ana.rey@iqvia.com
• Please note is necessary that your application is registered in our Talent Network (WorkDay) to process your candidacy

#LI-Hybrid #LI-AR4

IQVIA is a leading global provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions and clinical research services to the life sciences industry. We believe in pushing the boundaries of human science and data science to make the biggest impact possible – to help our customers create a healthier world. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

jobs_results.title: CX Project Manager (TIP2024)
jobs_results.description:
Are you a fresh graduate looking to boost your career in a dynamic and innovative multinational?

Join our Talent Incubator Program and start your career journey at Schneider Electric!

Who we are and what we do.

In Schneider Electric, we are the leading digital partner in sustainability and efficiency for businesses, communities, and individuals. Our goal is for everyone to be able to make the most of our energy and resources through the integration of processes, software, Big Data, and cutting-edge energy technologies that enable integrated management of buildings, industries, and cities.

We are part of the TOP5 in the ranking of the best companies to work for in Spain 2023, present in over 110 countries with a diverse and disruptive team of over 135,000 people.

What You Can Expect.

We have created an innovative program including many learning, training, and disruptive experiences, with tailored content regarding sustainability and digital transformation, and focusing on... launching your professional career with us.

From the first day 1 an Agile, Transformative, and Inspiring program awaits you, where you’ll combine your work hands-on work experience (being actively integrated into the day-to-day activities of your teams) with training and mentoring, and the development of a project sponsored by a member of our management committee.

We are looking for people like you, who are willing to embrace this challenge and develop the potential you have within.

Position title: CX Project Manager

Where will you work?

CS&Q is responsible for managing and improving every interaction throughout a customer's journey with Schneider. This includes understanding the customer's needs, preferences, and pain points throughout their journey, and then designing, implementing, and monitoring strategies and initiatives to enhance our overall customer experience. It also involves ensuring that products or services meet established standards and customer expectations.

This position is crucial for aligning customer experience initiatives with the company's strategic objectives. Collaborating closely with various teams and leaders provides the opportunity to influence decision-making processes that directly impact customer perception and satisfaction. Understanding customer needs and preferences enables advocating for customer-centric solutions that not only enhance the overall customer experience but also drive business growth, customer retention, and long-term loyalty. Additionally, ensuring that products or services meet established standards and customer expectations through processes to identify, address, and prevent issues in order to maintain high quality standards.

What will you do?
• Gathering and analyzing customer feedback and data to identify areas for improvement; Developing and implementing customer-centric processes across various touchpoints; Collaborating with other departments to ensure a consistent and seamless customer experience; Sharing and promoting global customer experience programs within the organization;
• Measuring and sharing customer satisfaction KPIs with the organization;
• Driving initiatives to increase customer satisfaction, retention, and value;
• Implementing corrective actions when issues are identified;
• Communicating with customers about problems and solutions;
• Training staff in quality practices;
• Advocating for the customer within the organization to ensure their needs are prioritized in decision-making.

What will you learn?

This position will allow you to develop a holistic understanding of customer experience, business, and strategic alignment, while enhancing your interpersonal and professional skills.

Communication: Improving communication skills through interactions with diverse teams, leaders, and customers. Strategic Thinking: Learning to align customer experience initiatives with the company's strategic objectives and contribute to decision-making processes. Customer-Centric Mindset: Understanding and advocating for customer needs, preferences, and solutions. Collaboration: Working closely with different teams and leaders to influence customer perception and satisfaction. Business Acumen: Gaining insights into how customer experience impacts business growth, customer retention, and long-term loyalty.

What You Bring:
• Fresh graduate in Management or Engineering
• Be able to start a 1-year program in May 2024.
• Fluent in English and Spanish, written and spoken. Portuguese is a plus.
• Analytical skills and intermediate level of Excel (Basic – Pivots and formulas, Macros - is a plus).
• Basic/intermediate level in Power Point. Knowledge of Agile methodologies and Design Thinking is a plus.
• Collaborative and curious, Active listening, Problem-solving skills, and innovative. Empathy and proactivity.

What we offer?

· An open-ended contract with a very competitive compensation package

· A unique experience specially designed for your learning and development

· The opportunity to meet others talented workers colleagues and develop your network around through activities and bootcamps

· The development of a Game Changer project with Agile methodologies.

· Depending on the position, rotations into different teams inside or outside of your department for 1 month or more

· Careers opportunities

What is the application process?

Step 1 – Online Application

Step 2 - Online recorded video interview

Step 3 – Online Competencies test

Step 4 – Online Escape Room

Step 5 - Online Interview

Places are filled on a first-come, first-served basis. We would recommend early application to avoid disappointment!.

Benefits.
• We adapt to you! :
• With our flexible schedule, you'll have the freedom to adjust your working hours to accommodate your personal needs and responsibilities.

💻 We understand the benefits of working from home. With our hybrid work plan, you can enjoy working hours from the comfort of your own home.

🏝 Need more time to relax and unwind? With our Holy Pack, you can purchase additional vacation days to recharge whenever you need it most.

📅 Celebrate holidays your way! With Floating Holidays, you can exchange public holidays for other days that better suit your plans and personal preferences.

🧘‍♂️ Need extra time to explore new experiences or focus on personal projects? With the Sabbatical Pack, you can request up to 2 months of additional unpaid leave.

💞 We value the importance of family and want to support you in all aspects of your life. Our Global Family Leave Policy provides flexible paid conditions for when you need it most, whether you're about to become a parent, need time to overcome a loss, or care for a loved one.

· We take care of you! :

📱 With access to the health and wellness platform Wellwo, you and up to 5 people of your choice can enjoy virtual medical care and 24/7 psychological support, as well as access to nutritional advice, guided classes, and much more!

🏄‍♂️ From attending dance classes to booking a hotel spa, we offer a partnership with AJ by Gympass, giving you access to a network of thousands of gyms and sports centers, so you can keep your body active in the way you prefer.

🩺 Your well-being is our priority. You'll have medical services available at your workplace for close attention to any medical needs.

· We empower you! :

🎯 With Open Talent Market, our AI-driven professional development platform, you can connect with job opportunities, projects, and mentors at Schneider Electric globally.

🤑 We offer you the opportunity to become a shareholder of Schneider Electric and share in our achievements through our employee share ownership program.

🙌 We celebrate talent and success offor all with our recognition program, where you can give and receive points for your accomplishments and redeem them for gift cards at your favorite stores.

💗 You'll have life insurance for your protection.

💰 We offer a Flexible Compensation Plan, where you can choose from a variety of options such as health insurance, meal vouchers, childcare vouchers, transportation vouchers, training, and more.

🛒 As part of our #SEGreatPeople, you'll have access to an online store with Schneider Electric products at exclusive prices and super discounts.

🎁 With Club Schneider, you'll enjoy special discounts at your favorite stores, restaurants, travel agencies, and other external services.

💚 Participate in company-sponsored volunteer programs to contribute to our community and make a positive impact in your surroundings.

Disclaimer
• We seek out and reward people for putting the customer first, being disruptingve to the status quo, embracing different perspectives, continuously learning, and acting like owners. We want our employees to reflect the diversity of the communities in which we operate. We welcome people as they are, creating an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity are seen as a real value for the company. We’re looking for people with a passion for success — on the job and beyond

Why us?

Schneider Electric is leading the digital transformation of energy management and automation. Our technologies enable the world to use energy in a safe, efficient and sustainable manner. We strive to promote a global economy that is both ecologically viable and highly productive.

€25.7bn global revenue

137 000+ employees in 100+ countries

45% of revenue from IoT

5% of revenue devoted for R&D

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled

It is the policy of Schneider Electric to provide equal employment and advancement opportunities in the areas of recruiting, hiring, training, transferring, and promoting all qualified individuals regardless of race, religion, color, gender, disability, national origin, ancestry, age, military status, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristic or conduct. Concerning agencies: Schneider Electric does not accept unsolicited resumes and will not be responsible for fees related to such

jobs_results.description: It takes the brightest minds to be a technology leader. It takes imagination to create green energy for the generations to come. At Siemens Gamesa we make real what matters, join our global team. Creates and executes project work plans to meet changing needs and requirement of digitalization within a project. Siemens Gamesa has a vision for renewable energy: we believe in the power of nature and technology. Help us to be ready to face the energy challenges of tomorrow and make a green footprint – join the team in creating a better future for us on our planet. We focus on hiring the best people, wherever they may be in the world. We pride ourselves on the flexibility we offer to our employees and are committed to building a workforce that can grow with the company. Siemens Gamesa is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. In our culture of trust, we focus on empowerment, diversity and continuous... learning. Valuing our people is what makes us one global team, with our colleagues’ safety at the heart of our organization. Sponsored projects devoted to developing new performance improvements features, together with presales site specific tailoring of the wind turbines are demanding many load calculations in order to cover the demand. How to contribute to our vision Engage with nacelle plants’ stakeholders in order to get AS-IS situation of needs, information for project, and ensure implementations for all plants. Establish requirements from plants. Analyze other plants and check digitalization status. Concept definition: Investigate what has been developed about this concept in the market, in other SGRE areas and in other plants. Define what is viable to implement within the scope given for a particular need. Update weekly documents/system to give constant visibility of project. Provide project quality reporting and documentation. Be able to visit plant in Agreda (Soria) on a weekly basis. Be able to travel up to 30% a year to other plants in US, Asia, Europe. Establish a time plan for each project aligning with different stakeholders ensuring success of implementation. Be able to breakdown the time plan into a weekly action plant. Budget management: be ablet to gather the cost of hardware and software development from external partners. Plan contingencies that could fail and plan for back-up plans (risk management and mitigation plan). Manage prototype: Design and plan how the prototype will happen, how and when. Then what changes would need to happen for implementing in other plants. Set KPIs for the solution: design how the development of the solution can be measured and tracked once it is implemented. Develop business case to ensure that the reduction time when implementing a digital solution compensates the costs. Ensure and promote the identification and exploitation of opportunities of the project. Analyze economic feasibility and its impact in internal processes. Requirements and Quality Management: Establish and manage the quality of the service/product to be delivered and the delivery process being managed: and to recognize quality as an invaluable tool for the benefits. Comply with defined, internal protocols and standards. Ensure compliance with all internal and external rules, laws, standards and guidelines. Capture and communicate learnings: Gather project learnings and develop documentation for best practices. Document test results. Lead project ensuring requirements are in place, adherence to schedule and implementation liaising with blue collars. Shape and execute SIPOC. Create IT demand as per requirement in the internal system. Engage with IT stakeholders to ensure implementation gets done within agreed timeline. What you need to make a difference Skills: Proactivity: The drive and will to plan and develop until implementation new solutions. Proactivity for spotting ways where digitalization can decrease working time from nacelle plant (blue collars + white collars). Strong motivation for digitalization and digital transformation. Strong entrepreneurial spirit. Innovative and creative in thinking. Collaboration & influencing: Build and maintain personal relationships and to understand that the ability to engage with others is a precondition for collaboration, commitment and, ultimately, performance. Business-Results Orientation: Focus on the agreed outcomes and drive towards making the project a success. Project Culture and Values: Recognize and integrate the influence of internal and external cultural aspects on the project approach, objectives, processes, sustainability of the outcomes and agreed outcomes. Follow company values: Result orientation - Results are relevant, delivered in a timely manner and at appropriate cost. Customer focus - Think from a customer's perspective about how we can excel in delivery. Innovativeness - New solutions for customers and ourselves. Impactful leadership - Inspiring our people and exemplifying the culture and common values. Ownership attitude - People are motivated and engaged and see themselves as drivers of business success. Valuing people - Valuing the importance of the individual. Respect for other individuals on tone and actions. Ability to evaluate specific work situations and to decide appropriate action based upon decision-making principles and sound judgment. Strategic-Innovative Orientation: Understand the strategy and strategic processes, thus enabling a certain management domain to manage their project within the contextual aspects. Be able to manage several initiatives / projects at the same time. Have control over them in order to be able to provide status at any time. Guarantee the inclusion, monitoring and control of project risk related to all the functions and tasks during the execution phase. Communication skills: ensure proper communication with manager, team and stakeholders with trust and transparency. Escalate issues or difficulties as soon as foreseen to manager. Negotiation skills: Make agreements with other parties so that the solution gets finally implemented. Ability to engage stakeholders on getting information. Problem solving: Come with new initiatives when there is a problem happening. Think of alternative possibilities to solve the problem. Investigating skills: for latent issues in the plant. Also, when there is a problem to find the root cause and find the solution. How is that solution being developed so far. Change management (accompanying process and organizational changes) Teamwork: support the rest of the team and ensure constructive feedback is given. Empathetic and engaging. Able to motivate people across all layers of the organization. Be flexible in order to modify project if needed in order to meet management expectation. Be able to have a timing plan for the long and the short-term execution. The ability to review topics from a detailed perspective and to bigger picture thinking. Also, flexible when working with other cultures and international backgrounds. Participate in diversity inclusion. Qualifications / Experience: Electronic / Electric Engineering degree / Computing degree Preferably Digitalization Master / degree Min of 3 years experience with Wind Turbines production / manufacturing. Min. of 5 years as Project Manager. Educational background or previous working experience in technologies VR/AR, 3D print, Digital Twin, Big Data, Robots/Cobots, IoT, Cybersecurity, Cloud computing. Educational background or previous working experience in IoT architecture e in order to assess on sensors, PLC and map the machine data into SGRE network with a different server. Fluency in written and spoken Spanish and English. In return of your commitment, we offer you… Become a part of our mission for sustainability: Clean energy for generations to come. A global team of diverse colleagues who share passion for renewable energy. Trust and empowerment to make your own ideas reality. Personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization. Flexible working hours as well as home-office Attractive remuneration package Local benefits such as subsided lunch, employee discounts and much more Empowering our people https://www.siemensgamesa.com/sustainability/employees How do you imagine the future? https://youtu.be/12Sm678tjuY Our global team is on the front line of tackling the climate crisis, reducing carbon emissions – the greatest challenge we face. Severely disabled applicants are encouraged to reach out to us. We have inclusive recruiting processes specifically for severely disabled persons in Germany and we do our utmost to tailor working spaces to suit your individual needs. In cases of severe disability, applicants who are equally qualified will be given preferential consideration. Siemens Gamesa is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a work environment that is free from discrimination and where employees are treated with dignity and respect. Employment at Siemens Gamesa is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications, which are directly related to job competence. Siemens Gamesa does not discriminate against any employee or job applicant on the basis of race, ethnicity, nationality, ancestry, genetic information, citizenship, religion, age, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, rules or regulations. We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, training, compensation, promotion and benefits. We are driven by people - from more than 100 different countries, they build the company we are every day. Our diverse and inclusive culture encourages us to think outside the box, speak without fear, and be bold. We value the flexibility that our smart-working arrangements, our digital disconnection framework and our family-friendly practices bring to the new way of working. With a worldwide installed capacity of 124 GW, Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy has a presence in more than 100 countries and a team of 27,000 people worldwide. Its end-to-end value chain presence encompasses onshore and offshores wind turbines design, manufacturing, installation as well as cutting-edge service solutions. The global headquarters and legal domicile of the company is located in Zamudio, Spain. The company is listed on the Spanish Stock Exchange

jobs_results.title: Business Innovation Project Manager SWR
jobs_results.description:
Job Purpose

We are looking for an Business Innovation Project Manager for Bridgestone. This position is located in our Madrid office.

The main responsibilities are:
• Project Management Office, for successful project delivery and synergies optimization
• New Business model innovation, scouting opportunities for value creation
• Driving Mobility agenda, aligning BS entities common vision

Key Responsibilities

Project Management Office, ensuring timely execution in order to support growth objectives [40%]
• Strategic formulation
• Business cases development based on ROIC
• Internal buy-in process coordination
• Support functions alignment (Finance / Legal / Marketing / M&A…)
• Project Management & Product owner
• Roll out plans coordination with operations teams (BMS / Wholesale / Retail)
• Follow-up progress of milestones/goals through regular reviews & reporting
• Partnership management with third entities

Business Models innovation [25%]
• Encouraging to operational departments... for business expansion
• Analyzing data and trends to improve business performance
• Evaluate and implement new concepts and technologies to accelerate business development
• Business model definition (ideation)
• Synergies identification within other BS entities

Business Moldel Incubation [25%]
• Scouting opportunities with start-ups to enrich the group value proposition
• Identify and exploit partnership and growth opportunities for businesses
• Structuring potential partnerships for growth
• Facilitate and manage communication between entrepreneurs and their business partners
• Supporting the training and education of entrepreneurs

Collaborate with other BS entities to drive Mobility agenda [10%]
• Market intelligence: Understanding of mobility market trends, technology state of the art and fleet current / future expectations
• Facilitate SW strategy deployment within the mobility ecosystem (Connected, Shared, Electric, …)
• Participating in internal workgroups within EMIA organization and establishing direct connections with key EMIA stakeholders
• Best practices sharing: internal and external
• Participating in industry forums and Mobility associations
• Identifying business opportunities with local New Mobility Players (new eOEM)

Required Capabilities
• Bachelor's degree, and specialisation in Project Management. Knowledge in mobility, innovation can be considered as a plus.
• At least 5 years of experience in Project Management and demonstrable participation in innovation projects. Work experience in companies related to mobility is valued
• Spanish and English fluent (Group language) and Portuguese / French can be considered as a plus
• Willingness to travel
• Proficient Office 365 user
• Required Softskills:
• Strong values in line with Bridgestone’s behavioral expectations and embracing the Bridgestone Essence Philosophy
• High communication skills
• Agility – ability to work in a matrix and complex environment where change happens at a rapid pace
• Courage – ability to share ideas, make proposals for change
• Analytical skills, precise, rigorous and familiarity with numbers
• Strong ability to meet deadlines - reliable
• Ability to work within international environment different cultures

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
💪 Salesforce Project Manager 💪 (100% remote)

Expected Functions / Key Results:
• Responsible for overseeing the production of deliverables, managing and running complex enterprise projects, ensuring timely closeout of requirements and projects, providing timely status updates to the clients, and working closely with various technical and non-technical team members.
• Participate in client discovery sessions with a primary focus on documentation of existing business processes and identifying client needs.
• Managing a team of developers and consultants in developing Salesforce projects.
• Developing metrics for each project to determine paths to success.
• Communicating effectively with team members and stakeholders and acting as the first point of contact for clients.
• Conducting regular project meetings with your Project team.
• Ensuring that your team produces work that adheres to Salesforce's best-design principles.

Requirements:
• 3 + years of experience working with... Salesforce on different platforms.
• Salesforce Certifications.
• Project experience with Health organizations is a plus.
• Salesforce administration/configuration work (for example: workflow rules, process builder, UX updates, reporting, etc.)
• Expertise in project management tooling and workflows (Jira, Wrike, etc.)
• Presentation, meeting, planning, and communication experience across various audiences (in-team, cross-team, executive, etc.)
• Familiarity with Agile Software Development Methodologies.
• Strong oral and written communication skills in English and Spanish.

🤝 Conditions:

💰 Up to 45.000€ based on knowledge and experience + beneficts

📍 Madrid and Barcelona

⏱ Flexible working hours

🌎 100% remote (Spain)

If you are interested in hearing more, get in touch! 👍

jobs_results.title: Transformation and Project Manager  BNP Paribas Factor
jobs_results.description:
BNP Paribas Group is the top bank in the European Union and a major international banking establishment. It has close to 184,000 employees in 64 countries. In Spain we are more than 5,000 employees within 12 business lines.

BNP Paribas Factor meets the financing needs of companies locally, in terms of import and export, and beyond Spain's borders with its international products and offers a wide range of factoring services through its offices in Madrid, Barcelona and Bilbao.

MISSION:

Support BNP Paribas Factor Iberia Management and coordinate the framing, design and implementation of projects and operating models to drive the Entity transformation journey, locally and at Iberian level.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Oversee the delivery of complex projects and activities and ensure quality of deliverables and adherence to deadlines.
• Ensure meaningful project structure and governance, as well as management of key stakeholders, represent projects in key stakeholder (OpCo, SteerCo) and report... directly to project sponsors.
• Ensure method is applied to frame and execute programme, projects, or specific complex project streams, on time, on quality and on budget.
• Cross-manage the various contributors (IT, key users ...) in the various project phases (scoping, implementation, tests and deployment)
• Lead meetings, workshops or internal trainings, using pertinent techniques and providing perceptive results.
• Be a business advisor and coacher of Continuous Improvement related topics such as Process Efficiency, Automation, Digital & Artificial Intelligence or Data Management.
• Support clients in implementing project outcomes and follow-up outcomes with clients.
• Take responsibility for the delivery of presentations and reporting for clients and management.
• Provide continuous support and coaching to the other team members.
• Promote the knowledge sharing within the team.
• Foster and contribute to continuous improvement mindset within the team and with client.
• Ensure the efficient management of project resources, including human resources.

REQUIREMENTS:

Training:

Masters in Business Management
Masters in Information Technology and Computer Science
Experience:

Project Management and Consulting (5 - 7 years)
Banking and Financial Operations (3 – 5 years), preferential

Languages:
• English:Fluent
• Portuguese:Beginner
SKILLS:

Technical:
• MS OFFICE PACK MICROSOFT EXCEL (Expert)
• MS OFFICE PACK MICROSOFT POWERPOINT (Expert)
• PROJECT MANAGEMENT Framing (Expert)

Trasversal & Behavioral:
• Ability to manage a project
• Attention to detail/rigor
• Client focused

Diversity and Inclusion commitment

BNP Paribas Group in Spain is an equal opportunity employer and proud to provide equal employment opportunity to all job seekers. We are actively committed to ensuring that no individual is discriminated against on the grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership status, pregnancy and maternity/paternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. Equity and diversity are at the core of our recruitment policy because we believe that they foster creativity and efficiency, which in turn increase performance and productivity. We strive to reflect the society we live in, while keeping with the image of our clients

jobs_results.title: ISIT Project Manager Financial Accounting - Finance & Legal
jobs_results.via: via Your Career Journey With Nestlé | Nestlé Global - Nestlé
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a ISIT Project Manager Financial Accounting - Finance & Legal for our IT Finance&Control and Legal team

Position Snapshot
• Location: Barcelona
• Type of Contract: Permanent, 100%
• IT Finance&Control and Legal - Financial Accounting
• Type of work: Hybrid
• Work Language: Fluent Business English

The role

We operate on a product management operative model. We are looking for a project manager to join our Financial Accounting product group, which includes the following products: General Ledger, Asset Accounting, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Tax, Travel & Expenses, Workplace Solutions. Each individual product owns several different applications.

The product team comprises a range of IT professionals from Nestlé as well as our application management partners.

The team is working through a product model for existing applications (roadmap and backlog evolution) and through the classical IT delivery phases - from requirements gathering and blueprinting... through design, build, test and deploy – for new applications.

The Team has global scope and responsibility.

What you’ll do

Requirement is for a strong project manager to support initiatives in the area of Accounts Receivable and notably the build and deployment of an integrated end to end e-commerce solution based on SAP technology.

The candidate will help define the plan and manage the day to day activities of the team, delivering to that plan. 

The role includes all conventional elements of project management like:
• Plan Definition
• Deliverable definition
• RACI definition
• Task and Action management
• Status reporting (to the program)
• Escalation management
• Communications
• Change management
• Facilitation /Integration

We offer you

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.
• Great benefits including competitive salary and a comprehensive social benefits package. We have one of the most competitive pension plans on the market, as well as flexible remuneration with tax advantages: health insurance, restaurant card, mobility plan, etc.
• Personal and professional growth through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
• Hybrid working environment with flexible working scheme. Our state-of-the-art campus is dog friendly and equipped with a medical center, canteen and areas to co-create network and chill!
• Recreation activities such as yoga, Zumba, etc. and a wide range of volunteering activities.

Minimum qualifications:
• Expectation is 10 years+ working in the area of Financial Accounting in an SAP context: General Ledger, Asset Accounting, integration with controlling, management accounting and other E2Es (source to Pay, Hire to Retire, Order to Cash), with focus on Accounts Receivable.
• IT project management skills are essential.
• Pure PMO profiles without experience in these areas will not be considered.
• 5 years+ Multi geography, multi market implementations including a deployment component to business.
• Consolidated experience working in a Corporate international complex environment.
• Consolidated experience in greenfield implementations.
• Knowledge of SAP S/4 Hana, FI-CA, BRIM can be beneficial but not essential.
• Highly developed in the key nestle Leadership Framework skills: result focus, proactive cooperation, and initiative.
• Excellent communication skills.

About the IT Hub

At Nestlé IT, we are a diverse, global team of IT professionals in the biggest health, nutrition and wellness company of the world. We strive to create an environment where people are valued for who they are. We innovate every day through future ready technologies to create opportunities for Nestlé to delight consumers, customers and employees alike. We collaborate with partners around the world to deliver tangible value at global scale. We continuously work to develop our people to be future ready.

About Nestlé

We are Nestlé, the largest food and beverage company in the world, with a presence in more than 185 countries. With net sales of CHF 94.4 billion in 2022, the company has over 291,000 employees and 418 factories in 85 countries. Our values are based on respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity, and respect for our future. Nestlé is dedicated to offering high-quality food and beverage products and services that contribute to the nutrition, health, and well-being of people, pets, and the planet. Additionally, it is committed to being a leading company in sustainability and achieving net zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050. Want to learn more? Visit us at: www.nestle.com

We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.

Step outside your comfort zone; share your ideas, way of thinking and working to make a difference to the world, every single day. You own a piece of the action – make it count.

Join Nestlé’s IT Hub #beaforceforgood

How we will proceed:

You send us your CV → We contact relevant applicants → Interviews → Feedback → Job Offer communication to the Finalist → First working day
